rationale: Concrete panel detailer or draftsperson in Melbourne's northern suburbs on industrial, commercial and residential building projects; the advert says it will train people with no panel detailing experience and suits drafting and engineering students or new graduates.

Asks for some 2D AutoCAD and/or 3D Tekla, a building industry education or work background, and the ability to visualise in 3D from 2D drawings. Marc has AutoCAD 2D/3D from his Advanced Diploma, a footing and column modelled in 3D in AutoCAD, and reviewed structural and architectural drawings on site in the Philippines.
Victoria based and commutable from Melton; the work is building structure detailing rather than civil roads and drainage, so discipline overlap is partial.
caution: No Tekla and no panel detailing experience (the advert says neither is required). AutoCAD use is academic, not paid production drafting. SEEK asks years as a draftsperson: the honest answer is none in a paid role.
gaps: No concrete panel detailing experience (advert says training is offered)
AutoCAD and Revit use is from study, not commercial drafting
apply_instructions: SEEK Quick Apply with cover letter and resume (the advert says to email cover letter and resume through the Quick apply button). No closing date stated; SEEK listing expires 16 November 2026.
title: CONCRETE PANEL DETAILER / DRAFTSPERSON
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
